summary: 31-year-old man from Grand Junction triggered a Garmin SOS in Columbine Basin (~13,000 ft) above Bridal Veil Falls reporting a 150-200 ft fall and believed broken leg; turned out he had been BASE jumping and his parachute failed to deploy; he declined the helicopter and SAR assistance and hiked out on foot with a friend, watched over by San Juan County SAR
location: Columbine Basin, above Bridal Veil Falls, Telluride
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office, San Miguel County SAR, San Juan County SAR, CARE Flight
notes: ~20 SAR members and deputies committed ~9 hours; TNS did not name the man (he later published his own account at colemansperando.com disputing parts of the sheriff's statement)
